'''Greg Anderson''' was named on Decipher's first team of Star Wars '''Player Advocates''', listed under '''Rules Support''' with [[Joe Helfrich]].<ref name="pc1">[https://web.archive.org/web/20020611042314/http://decipher.com/starwars/playerscommittee1.html The Star Wars Players' Committee], decipher.com (Wayback, 11 June 2002; letter dated 25 January 2002)</ref> Early swccgpc.com Advocate Council pages list him as '''Rules Advocate'''.<ref name="council2002">[https://web.archive.org/web/20021209221742/http://www.swccgpc.com/council.htm Advocate Council], swccgpc.com (Wayback, 9 December 2002)</ref><ref name="council2004">[https://web.archive.org/web/20040603222905/http://www.swccgpc.com/council.htm Advocate Council], swccgpc.com (Wayback, 3 June 2004)</ref><ref name="council2005">[https://web.archive.org/web/20050829220138/http://www.swccgpc.com/council.htm Advocate Council], swccgpc.com (Wayback, 29 August 2005)</ref>

This page is a '''fan encyclopedia''' stub.

== Documented PC roles ==

* '''January 2002:''' First Advocates roster &mdash; Rules Support (with Joe Helfrich).<ref name="pc1" />
* '''Advocate Council:''' Rules Advocate on council.htm snapshots from December 2002, June 2004, and August 2005.<ref name="council2002" /><ref name="council2004" /><ref name="council2005" />
